description: Mada hii inafundisha stadi za kusoma kwa ufahamu, kupata wazo kuu na mawazo saidizi, kufahamu maana ya msamiati katika muktadha, na kujibu maswali ya ufahamu kwa usahihi.

mcq.questionText: Soma kifungu kifuatacho kisha ujibu swali: "Juma aliamka mapema asubuhi akaenda shambani kupalilia mahindi. Jua lilipopanda, alirudi nyumbani kupumzika na kunywa maji. Alasiri alirejea tena shambani kumalizia kazi." Kifungu hiki kinahusu nini hasa?​

options.text: Shughuli za Juma za kilimo katika siku moja
Safari ya Juma ya kwenda mjini

mcq.explanation: The passage describes Juma's farming activities (weeding maize) throughout a single day, so option (a) captures the main idea.

mcq.questionText: Kusoma kwa ufahamu maana yake ni nini?

options.text: Kusoma kwa sauti kubwa bila kuelewa
Kusoma matini huku ukielewa maana na ujumbe wake

mcq.explanation: Reading for comprehension means reading a text while understanding its meaning and message, not merely pronouncing words.

mcq.questionText: Wazo kuu katika kifungu cha ufahamu ni lipi?

options.text: Mfano mmoja tu uliotolewa katika aya
Jambo kuu ambalo kifungu kizima kinalizungumzia
Sentensi ya mwisho ya kifungu pekee

mcq.explanation: The main idea is the central point that the whole passage is about, not a single example or the last sentence.

mcq.questionText: Soma: "Maji ni uhai. Tunayatumia kunywa, kupika, kuoga na kunyweshea mimea. Pasipo maji, viumbe hai havingeweza kuishi." Mawazo saidizi katika kifungu hiki ni yapi?
mcq.explanation: Supporting ideas explain or expand the main idea; here they are the various uses of water (drinking, cooking, bathing, watering plants).

mcq.questionText: Soma: "Mwalimu aliwasihi wanafunzi kufanya bidii ili wafaulu mtihani." Neno "aliwasihi" lina maana gani katika muktadha huu?
mcq.explanation: In context, 'aliwasihi' means he earnestly pleaded with or urged them, fitting the meaning of encouraging hard work.

mcq.questionText: Ili kupata maana ya msamiati katika muktadha, msomaji anapaswa kufanya nini?

options.text: Kuangalia maneno na sentensi zinazozunguka neno hilo
Kubadilisha neno hilo na jina lake

mcq.explanation: Contextual meaning is found by examining the surrounding words and sentences that give clues to a word's meaning.

mcq.questionText: Soma: "Mvua kubwa ilinyesha usiku kucha. Asubuhi, mito ilifurika na madaraja kadhaa yalibomoka. Wakazi wa kijiji walilazimika kuhama makazi yao." Ni nini kilichowafanya wakazi kuhama?
mcq.explanation: The passage states heavy rain caused rivers to overflow and bridges to collapse, forcing residents to relocate.

mcq.questionText: Kichwa cha habari (kichwa cha kifungu) hutusaidiaje katika ufahamu?

options.text: Hutoa dalili ya kile kifungu kinachohusu
Huongeza idadi ya maneno bila maana

mcq.explanation: A title gives the reader a clue or hint about what the passage is about, aiding comprehension.

mcq.questionText: Soma: "Asha alikuwa mwanafunzi mwenye nidhamu. Hakuwahi kuchelewa darasani wala kukosa kufanya kazi za nyumbani." Neno "nidhamu" lina maana gani hapa?

options.text: Mwenendo mzuri na utii wa kanuni

mcq.explanation: From the context (never late, never skips homework), 'nidhamu' means good conduct and obedience to rules, i.e. discipline.

mcq.questionText: Hatua ya kwanza nzuri ya kufanya unapotaka kujibu maswali ya ufahamu ni ipi?

options.text: Kujibu maswali kabla ya kusoma kifungu
Kusoma kifungu kwa makini kabla ya kuangalia maswali

mcq.explanation: A good first step is to read the passage carefully (often more than once) to understand it before answering questions.

mcq.questionText: Soma: "Baba alimnunulia mwanawe baiskeli mpya kwa sababu alifaulu vizuri mtihani." Kwa nini baba alimnunulia mwanawe baiskeli?

options.text: Kwa sababu mwana alifaulu vizuri mtihani
Kwa sababu baba alikuwa na fedha nyingi

mcq.explanation: The passage gives the reason directly: the father bought the bicycle because his son passed the exam well.

mcq.questionText: Soma: "Ingawa alikuwa maskini, Bw. Hamisi alikuwa mkarimu sana; mara kwa mara aliwapa majirani zake chakula." Neno "mkarimu" linamaanisha mtu wa namna gani?

options.text: Mwenye kupenda kutoa na kusaidia wengine

mcq.explanation: The context (sharing food with neighbours) shows 'mkarimu' means generous, one who likes giving and helping others.

mcq.questionText: Kifungu cha ufahamu kinaweza kuwa cha aina mbalimbali. Ipi kati ya zifuatazo NI aina ya kifungu cha ufahamu?
mcq.explanation: Comprehension passages come in types such as narrative (story), descriptive, and expository; a narrative passage is one valid type.

mcq.questionText: Soma: "Wanafunzi walipanda miti mingi shuleni ili kuhifadhi mazingira na kupata kivuli." Dhamira au lengo la wanafunzi kupanda miti lilikuwa nini?
mcq.explanation: The passage explicitly states the purpose: to conserve the environment and provide shade.

mcq.questionText: Kwa nini ni muhimu kusoma kifungu cha ufahamu zaidi ya mara moja?

options.text: Ili kuelewa vizuri zaidi na kupata maelezo uliyoyakosa

mcq.explanation: Reading more than once helps deepen understanding and catch details missed during the first reading.

fib.questionText: Jambo kuu ambalo kifungu kizima kinalizungumzia huitwa wazo _____.
fib.explanation: The central point of a whole passage is called the main idea (wazo kuu).

fib.questionText: Mawazo yanayofafanua na kuunga mkono wazo kuu huitwa mawazo _____.
fib.explanation: Ideas that explain and support the main idea are called supporting ideas (mawazo saidizi).

fib.questionText: Kusoma matini huku ukielewa maana yake huitwa kusoma kwa _____.
fib.explanation: Reading while understanding the meaning is called reading for comprehension (kusoma kwa ufahamu).

fib.questionText: Maana ya neno inayopatikana kwa kuangalia maneno yanayolizunguka huitwa maana katika _____.
fib.explanation: The meaning of a word found from surrounding words is called contextual meaning (maana katika muktadha).

fib.questionText: Maneno mapya au yasiyozoeleka katika kifungu huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: New or unfamiliar words in a passage are referred to as vocabulary (msamiati).

fib.questionText: Soma: "Mtoto alilia kwa sababu alikuwa na njaa." Sababu ya mtoto kulia ilikuwa ni _____.
fib.explanation: The passage states the child cried because of hunger (njaa).

fib.questionText: Maneno machache yanayotoa dalili ya kile kifungu kinachohusu na yaliyo juu ya kifungu huitwa _____ cha habari.
fib.explanation: The short words above a passage hinting at its content form the title (kichwa cha habari).

fib.questionText: Soma: "Salima alikuwa hodari darasani; alipata alama za juu kuliko wenzake wote." Neno "hodari" lina maana ya kuwa na _____.
fib.explanation: From context (highest marks), 'hodari' means being skilled/able, i.e. having ability or competence.

fib.questionText: Kabla ya kujibu maswali ya ufahamu, ni vyema kwanza kukisoma kifungu kwa _____.
fib.explanation: Before answering comprehension questions, one should first read the passage carefully (kwa makini).

fib.questionText: Soma: "Mafuriko yaliharibu mazao yote shambani." Neno "mazao" linamaanisha vitu vinavyolimwa au _____ shambani.
fib.explanation: In context, 'mazao' refers to crops, i.e. things that are grown or harvested from the farm.

tf.questionText: Kusoma kwa ufahamu kunahusisha kuelewa maana na ujumbe wa matini, siyo kutamka maneno tu.
tf.explanation: Reading for comprehension involves understanding meaning and message, not just pronouncing words.

tf.questionText: Wazo kuu na wazo saidizi ni kitu kimoja chenye maana sawa kabisa.
tf.explanation: They differ: the main idea is the central point, while supporting ideas explain or back it up.

tf.questionText: Maana ya neno inaweza kubadilika kulingana na muktadha ambamo limetumika.
tf.explanation: A word's meaning can change depending on the context in which it is used.

tf.questionText: Ni sahihi kujibu maswali ya ufahamu kabla ya kusoma kifungu chenyewe.
tf.explanation: One should read the passage first; answering before reading leads to errors.

tf.questionText: Kichwa cha habari kinaweza kumsaidia msomaji kutabiri yaliyomo katika kifungu.
tf.explanation: The title provides clues that help the reader predict the content of the passage.

tf.questionText: Kusoma kifungu mara moja tu daima kunatosha kupata ufahamu kamili.
tf.explanation: Reading once is often not enough; multiple readings help catch missed details and deepen understanding.

tf.questionText: Majibu mengi ya maswali ya ufahamu hupatikana ndani ya kifungu chenyewe.
tf.explanation: Most comprehension answers are found within the passage itself, directly or by inference.

tf.questionText: Soma: "Joto kali lilifanya watu wengi kuhisi kiu." Sentensi hii inaonyesha kuwa hali ya hewa ilikuwa ya baridi.
tf.explanation: The sentence mentions intense heat (joto kali) causing thirst, so the weather was hot, not cold.

tf.questionText: Mawazo saidizi husaidia kufafanua zaidi na kutoa mifano kuhusu wazo kuu.
tf.explanation: Supporting ideas elaborate on and give examples that clarify the main idea.

tf.questionText: Wakati wa kujibu swali la maana ya neno katika muktadha, tunapaswa kupuuza sentensi zinazozunguka neno hilo.
tf.explanation: We must use, not ignore, the surrounding sentences to determine a word's contextual meaning.

summary.correctAnswer: Ni kusoma matini huku ukielewa maana na ujumbe wake.
summary.explanation: Reading for comprehension means understanding the meaning and message of what is read.

summary.correctAnswer: Ni jambo kuu ambalo kifungu kizima kinalizungumzia.
summary.explanation: The main idea is the central point the entire passage addresses.

summary.correctAnswer: Ni mawazo yanayofafanua na kuunga mkono wazo kuu.
summary.explanation: Supporting ideas explain and back up the main idea with details and examples.

summary.correctAnswer: Ni maana ya neno inayopatikana kwa kuangalia maneno yanayolizunguka.
summary.explanation: Contextual meaning is derived from the surrounding words and sentences.

summary.questionText: Hatua ya kwanza ya kujibu maswali ya ufahamu
summary.correctAnswer: Ni kusoma kifungu kwa makini kabla ya kuangalia maswali.
summary.explanation: Reading the passage carefully first is the recommended initial step.

summary.correctAnswer: Hutoa dalili ya kile kifungu kinachohusu na kumsaidia msomaji.
summary.explanation: The title hints at the passage's content, aiding prediction and comprehension.

summary.questionText: Faida ya kusoma kifungu zaidi ya mara moja
summary.correctAnswer: Husaidia kuelewa vizuri zaidi na kupata maelezo yaliyokosekana.
summary.explanation: Rereading deepens understanding and recovers details missed earlier.

summary.questionText: Mahali pa kupata majibu ya maswali ya ufahamu
summary.correctAnswer: Hupatikana zaidi ndani ya kifungu chenyewe.
summary.explanation: Comprehension answers are mostly located in the passage itself.

summary.questionText: Aina mojawapo ya vifungu vya ufahamu
summary.explanation: Narrative is one common type of comprehension passage, alongside descriptive and expository.

summary.questionText: Tabia muhimu kwa msomaji bora wa ufahamu
summary.correctAnswer: Kusoma kwa makini na umakini bila kuruka maneno muhimu.
summary.explanation: A good comprehension reader reads attentively without skipping important words.

hoq.questionText: Soma: "Ingawa mvua ilinyesha kwa wingi msimu huu, wakulima wa kijiji cha Mlima walipata mavuno hafifu kwa sababu walipanda mbegu duni na hawakuweka mbolea." Ni hitimisho gani sahihi linaloweza kupatikana kutoka kifungu hiki?

options.text: Mvua ya kutosha pekee haitoshi kupata mavuno mengi; ubora wa mbegu na mbolea pia ni muhimu
Mvua nyingi husababisha mavuno hafifu kila wakati
Wakulima wa Mlima hawakupanda mazao yoyote

hoq.explanation: Despite plenty of rain, the poor harvest is attributed to poor seeds and no fertiliser, so the inference is that rain alone is insufficient; seed quality and fertiliser also matter.

hoq.questionText: Soma: "Watu walikimbia ovyo, wengine wakipiga kelele, huku moshi mzito ukifuka kutoka jengo la soko. Magari ya zimamoto yalifika kwa kasi." Kutokana na kifungu hiki, tunaweza kudokeza (kuhitimisha) kuwa nini kilitokea?

options.text: Kulizuka moto katika jengo la soko

hoq.explanation: Thick smoke, panic, and fire engines arriving are clues that allow the reader to infer that a fire broke out at the market.

hoq.questionText: Soma: "Neema aliahidi kumsaidia rafiki yake kusoma, lakini kila walipopanga kukutana, alikuwa na sababu ya kutohudhuria." Mwandishi anataka tuelewe nini kuhusu tabia ya Neema?

options.text: Neema ni mtu anayeshindwa kutimiza ahadi zake
Neema ni mwanafunzi bora kuliko wote
Neema na rafiki yake hawajawahi kuonana

hoq.explanation: By contrasting her promise with her repeated excuses for not showing up, the writer implies that Neema fails to keep her promises (unreliable).
